what: A groovebox that plays itself while you steer it: 22 genres and 220 pieces that play like tracks, with builds, breakdowns and fills. Pad, bass, 303-style acid and DX7 pluck voices, 21 drum kits plus your own samples, an auto-DJ, effects on the keys and a web studio. Works on the newer FM-1s too.
author: deamonSLINKY
sounds: public domain: 60 DX7 patches from public-domain banks (Bobby Blues and Dave Benson DX7 pages); CC0: three Freesound recordings (snips); everything else made in code
